label: Free legal help
text: For free legal advice, call the Lagos State Public Defender, toll-free 0800-006-7352 or 0800-002-7352.

label: Domestic and sexual violence support
text: Lagos State Domestic and Sexual Violence Agency: call 0800 033 3333, free, any time, for anyone of any age or gender. You can report without giving your name.

text: Mirabel Centre at LASUTH, Ikeja gives free medical care and counselling after sexual assault: 0818 724 3468 or 0815 577 0000.
